translations.web: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
translations.bsb: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.
translations.kjv: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
translations.asv: Till I come, give heed to reading, to exhortation, to teaching.
